about.title: Millbrae Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a crash on a corridor like El Camino Real, US-101, E Millbrae Avenue, or SR-82 takes a family member's life, the people left behind are often left sorting through insurance calls, medical records, and funeral costs all at once. San Mateo County families in this situation have a right under California law to pursue a wrongful death claim, but that right comes with real limits on who may file and how long they have to act. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves; we're a free service that connects grieving families in Millbrae with an independent personal injury attorney who can review what happened and explain the options. Traffic collision data for this area shows a steady flow of injury crashes, particularly on Thursday afternoons, which underscores how ordinary trips can turn tragic. You don't have to navigate this alone or figure out the legal steps by yourself.

whyChoose.title: Why Millbrae Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: We Understand Who Can File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse, domestic partner, or children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain situations. An attorney in our network can help sort out who in your family qualifies to bring a claim.

items.title: We Know the Clock Is Running
items.desc: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, though claims against a government entity carry a much shorter window. Connecting early with an attorney helps make sure that deadline isn't missed.

items.title: We Connect You at No Upfront Cost
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless they recover compensation for your family. That includes pursuing funeral costs, lost financial support, and the loss of companionship your family has suffered.

items.question: Who in my family is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: California law generally gives first priority to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children. If none of those exist, certain other dependents or heirs may have standing instead. An independent attorney can review your family's specific situation and explain who qualifies to bring the claim.

items.question: How long do we have to file after a fatal crash in Millbrae?
items.answer: In most cases, California gives you two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death lawsuit. That window shrinks significantly if a government entity, such as a public road authority, may share responsibility. Because Millbrae's busiest corridors include state routes like US-101 and SR-82, it's worth having this checked early.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case against the at-fault driver?
items.answer: No, a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action focused on financial and emotional losses to the family, not on criminal punishment. It can move forward whether or not criminal charges are filed or resolved. An attorney can walk you through how the two processes differ.
